ownership.role: Bounded correction of existing web V1 mechanics only

findings.title: Remove the unsupported RouteList creation prop
findings.body: Explore still passes onNewRoute to RouteList, but the unchanged RouteListProps accepts only routes, onViewRoute, onLogClimb, onDeleteRoute, and onEditRoute. This produces a TypeScript excess-prop error independently of the pending shared dependency and prevents the web build.

findings.title: Refresh and clear Explore data on authentication changes
findings.body: The route effect omits user.id, and the venue/climber fetch callbacks likewise depend only on search text. Authentication hydration therefore leaves anonymous bookmark/follow flags unchanged, while signing out or switching accounts with Bookmarks Only selected leaves account A's saved-route list rendered without an auth guard. Include viewer identity in request invalidation and clear account-scoped results and open selections before replacement queries.

findings.title: Normalize deep-linked route rows before opening their details
findings.body: The direct routes query does not return CommunityRoute.is_saved or image_url, yet its row is cast to that projection. A previously bookmarked outdoor route opened through routeId is therefore shown as unsaved and cannot be correctly toggled. For board routes that rely on their walls.image_url rather than a route snapshot, the missing wall join also makes the viewer fall back to the selected or demo wall. Resolve the canonical viewer-specific projection and actual image rather than casting the database row.

findings.title: Update the open route modal's bookmark state
findings.body: OutdoorRouteDetailModal reads route.is_saved from activeOutdoorRouteToView, but handleToggleBookmark updates only the routes array. After saving in the modal, it still says Save and a second activation again inserts rather than removing; an initially saved route similarly remains visually saved after deletion. Update or derive the selected route from the same state on success, optimistic changes, and rollback.

findings.title: Preserve the route's grade system in the Log handoff
findings.body: Explore sends discipline and grade_label but omits grade_system, and Log infers the system only from discipline. Selecting a Font boulder such as 7A therefore prefills its real label under v_scale and persists the wrong grading system unless the user manually corrects it; custom grades are also not representable in Log's selector. Carry and consume the canonical grade_system rather than guessing from discipline.

findings.title: Leave unknown route facts unset instead of publishing defaults
findings.body: A new route starts with an actual 5.11a grade and vertical terrain, and changing discipline substitutes V4; these are submitted as public facts without user input. Terrain has no unknown option and grade is required despite both fields being nullable in the contract. Initialize factual metadata as unset and require an actual value or persist null, rather than manufacturing grades and terrain for newly named climbs.

findings.title: Keep nested route actions out of the card's keyboard handler
findings.body: The card-level onKeyDown receives bubbling Enter/Space events from its nested Bookmark and Log Try buttons. It prevents their default activation and opens route details instead, while those child buttons stop only click propagation. Keyboard users therefore cannot activate the advertised direct actions. Handle only events targeting the card itself or use separate semantic navigation and action controls.

shared_contract: Existing canonical contract.json remains. Grade handoff adds gradeSystem alongside current routeId,routeName,discipline,grade. Explorer emits and Log consumes real canonical enum. Feed Beta navigates /explore?routeId=<id> rather than independent board fallback. SessionDetailModal optional onPublish(session) remains unchanged; Log loads selected session attempts by ID. Profile only consumes modal for private inspection. No backend API change. Designer V1Designer owns all UI interpretation.
